title: VP v1 data model, API surface and agent config: proposal from the authorized-surface synthesis
status: proposed (needs owner review; timing defaults are set by VP's own call battery, not by this file)
how_to_read: Each item says parity (most incumbents' APIs have it: confirmed from their APIs, not marketing) or beat (no incumbent API does it, or does it worse), with the evidence ids from research/2026-10-20/account-phase/*/claims.json. Names and shapes are VP's own design; no vendor schema or code is copied.

objects.name: Org > Workspace
objects.why: Retell/Vapi/ElevenLabs/Sarvam keep billing, keys and members off the API key (RAP-06, AP-01, AP-EL-05, SAC-50); Bolna exposes wallet + concurrency (ACB-04)
objects.beat: balance, spend cap, concurrency and invoices readable and settable through the API and the chat builder

objects.name: Agent
fields: versions[] (immutable: number, hash, parent, author, note)
objects.why: 4 of 5 version agents (AP-19, RAP-12, AP-EL-10, SAC-12); Bolna does not (ACB-07)
objects.beat: an edit never publishes (Vapi publishes on PATCH, ElevenLabs commits per write); every default is stored on create so the record is what runs (AP-18, ACB-08, AP-EL-14, RAP-20)

objects.name: Deployment
objects.why: pinning and splits exist at Vapi (AP-21), ElevenLabs (AP-EL-11), Sarvam (SAC-12), Retell tags/weights (RAP-13, RAP-48)

objects.name: Contact
objects.why: no contact at Bolna, Vapi, ElevenLabs (ACB-21, AP-12, AP-EL-08); Retell's contact misparses 10-digit Indian numbers to +1 and de-duplicates on the exact string (RAP-34); Sarvam has cohorts + an org DND list but no contact (SAC-17, SAC-18)

objects.name: Campaign
fields: window policy (derived from category; days; holidays; contact local time)
retry ladder by outcome {busy, no_answer, failed, short_call, voicemail, provider_error}: max + interval
attempt budget per contact per day/week
predial check (built-in scrub + optional customer hook)
state: draft | scheduled | running | paused | completed | cancelled
objects.why: retry ladders only at Sarvam (SAC-14) and Bolna batches (ACB-19); windows are whole hours (Bolna, ACB-54), absolute dates (Vapi, AP-27), one per batch with a US default (Retell, RAP-39), one start time (ElevenLabs, AP-EL-37) or free-form (Sarvam, SAC-15); a predial veto exists only at Vapi and needs the buyer's own hook (AP-32)

objects.name: Attempt
fields: precheck result (window, dnd, consent, budget, balance)
dial status: queued | dialing | ringing | no_answer | busy | failed | blocked | connected
objects.why: only Sarvam separates the dial from the conversation (SAC-19); Sarvam's carrier field is deprecated and always null (SAC-19)
objects.beat: the carrier and its code are kept; a blocked dial says which rule blocked it

objects.name: Conversation
fields: agent version + resolved stack actually used (models by dated id)
status: live | ended | processing | done | failed
objects.why: every vendor carries a typed record (ACB-21, AP-33, RAP-36, AP-EL-32, SAC-19); none records a business outcome beside the engineering code (AP-24 638 codes, RAP-35 39, AP-EL-33 5); Sarvam webhooks send English-only transcripts (SAC-29); ElevenLabs can reroute a model without an edit (AP-EL-25)

objects.name: OutcomeDefinition / Judge
objects.why: Bolna auto-creates two judges per agent and hides them from list endpoints (ACB-12, ACB-13); all five run post-call LLM analysis (ACB-12, AP-16, RAP-22, AP-EL-31, SAC-47) but none feeds results back to the prompt (AP-22, AP-EL-49, SAC-47, ACB-56)

objects.name: Tool
fields: type: http | transfer | end_call | sms | whatsapp | kb_query | code
objects.why: HTTP + transfer + end-call at 5 of 5 (ACB-43, AP-15, RAP-16, AP-EL-27, SAC-43); pre/post stages at Retell (RAP-17) and Sarvam (SAC-43)

objects.name: WebhookSubscription
fields: payload: slim (ids + status) with fetch link, or full
objects.why: signing at Retell, ElevenLabs, Vapi-optional (RAP-41, AP-EL-40, AP-31); none at Bolna execution webhooks or Sarvam (ACB-53, SAC-31); Vapi defaults to no retries and sends the full assistant + call on every event (AP-29, AP-31)

objects.name: Test (simulation)
fields: persona (Hinglish caller types from the l4b battery)
objects.beat: publish can be gated on a passing suite

languages.why: Bolna swaps the whole stack per language (ACB-46, ACB-47); ElevenLabs has an undocumented hinglish_mode boolean (AP-EL-20); Retell takes a locale array with no per-turn language ID (RAP-26)
languages.kind: beat if measured: language hold on the Hinglish battery

voice.provider: user choice from a curated list (decision.2026-10-20.product-stack-selectable)
voice.voice_id: validated against language (refuse a voice not verified for the agent language)
voice.why: ElevenLabs accepts its English default voice on a Hindi agent (AP-EL-21); Retell pronunciation alphabets have no Indic script (RAP-25); Bolna cuts TTS chunks at 40 characters (ACB-38)

brain.model: dated id, pinned; never rerouted without the owner
brain.why: ElevenLabs default LLM differs from its schema and is 2.4x the cost (AP-EL-14, AP-EL-26); deprecation fallback reroutes traffic (AP-EL-24)

opening.why: Bolna drops all caller speech during the welcome (ACB-35)

barge_in.short_reply_policy: classify (ack | objection | stop | answer); never discard

turn_taking.why: Bolna discards short finals and holds 900 ms after every final (ACB-32, ACB-34); Vapi's default acknowledgement/interruption lists are English (AP-47); ElevenLabs needs interruption_ignore_terms filled by hand (AP-EL-17, EL-P11); Sarvam exposes three coarse settings (SAC-36). VP's own stacks still cut in on 15-42% of turns (open.2026-10-19.turn-taking), so this is a beat only once measured.

call_control.end_call: agent-decided end with a goodbye per language (directive.2026-10-20.agent-hangup)

voicemail.detector: Indian operator-message lexicon (Hindi + regional) + early exit

call_control.why: Bolna's voicemail prompt lists no Hindi or regional carrier messages and waits up to 30 s (ACB-41)

transfer.why: Bolna transfers are cold in the open-source engine (ACB-42); Retell and Sarvam offer warm (RAP-16, SAC-21)

analysis.outcomes: customer enum mapped to business language

compliance.ai_disclosure: on by default on every creation path (API, chat, dashboard); one light line
compliance.why: Retell's disclosure preset is on for dashboard agents and absent on API-created ones (RAP-20)

privacy.why: ElevenLabs retention -1 and recording on by default (AP-EL-51); Retell PII list rejects Aadhaar (RAP-23)

validation.why: Bolna, Retell and ElevenLabs accept and drop unknown fields (ACB-09, RAP-10, AP-EL-15); only Vapi rejects them (AP-02)

attempt: prechecked (or blocked: window | dnd | consent | budget | balance)
connected | no_answer | busy | failed | invalid_number | carrier_blocked
state_machine.why: every vendor has a post-call processing phase between ended and final (Bolna call-disconnected -> completed; Retell call_ended -> call_analyzed; ElevenLabs processing -> done; Vapi end-of-call-report; Sarvam post-call webhook): ACB-21 summary §6, RAP-41, AP-EL-33, AP-33, SAC-29

cost_lines_inr: brain (tokens: input, cached, output; speculative separately)
cost_why: four vendors put typed cost lines on the call (ACB-21, AP-35, RAP-51, AP-EL-34); none groups cost by campaign or contact (AP-37, RAP-45); Sarvam bills agent minutes in 60-s pulses, so a 30-s call costs INR 7.40 per connected minute at PAYG (SAR-38)
